Stephanie & Jonathan
Your Wedding Week in Costa Rica

Everything for your week at Los Sueños in one place: a proposed plan for the days around the wedding, the group experiences for you and your guests, and the transport. All prices are approximate and shown in US dollars plus 13% tax.

Proposed Itinerary

A first idea built around what you shared on our call: a relaxed, vacation feel, a few signature Costa Rica experiences your guests can join, and evenings that end early enough for those who like to be in bed by 10:00 pm. Everything can move around to suit you.

Mon1Mar
You arrive

Settle in at Los Sueños Marriott a day before the guests start arriving.

Tue2Mar
Guests arrive

The busiest arrival day. Airport shuttles from SJO, grouped by arrival time.

Wed3Mar
Easy day before the wedding

Pool and beach time. For those who want it, a morning of sportfishing from the Los Sueños marina or a round of golf at La Iguana, both back by early afternoon.

Thu4Mar
Your wedding day

Los Sueños Marriott.

Fri5Mar
Private sunset catamaran

A slow morning after the wedding, then the whole group sails together in the afternoon, with an option to end the evening with dinner in Manuel Antonio.

Date being confirmed: Friday or Saturday
Sat6Mar
Monkey Island

A private afternoon boat tour through the Damas mangroves for your group, with pickup at the hotel.

Sun7Mar
Horseback on the beach, and a free day

Your horseback ride on the beach with a few friends, timed with the low tide. Everyone else can enjoy a last beach day or the Adventure Park, where each guest picks their own activity.

Mon8Mar
Off to your honeymoon

Private transfer to the Royal Corin in La Fortuna, leaving around 10:00 am with a stop for lunch, arriving around 3:00 pm.

Sat13Mar
Flight home

Private transfer from the Royal Corin to SJO, timed with your flight.

Private Sunset Catamaran

Two private boats, just for your group. Both sail from Marina Pez Vela in Quepos, about an hour and a quarter south of Los Sueños. The difference is the size of the group and how the afternoon runs.

Up to 40 guests
The all-inclusive sunset sail

Everything is taken care of, door to door.

Included
  • Round trip transport from Los Sueños Marriott, pickup around 12:15 pm
  • Open bar, fresh ceviche and snacks
  • Dinner on board at sunset
Private boat for your group
approx$5,850 + tax, up to 40 guests
About $150 + tax for each guest above 40.
Up to 100 guests
The big group catamaran

Room for everyone, with swim and snorkel stops along the way.

Included
  • About 1:30 pm to 6:00 pm on the water
  • Drinks and cocktails, fresh fruit and lunch
  • Snorkeling and swim stops
  • Open on both Friday and Saturday
Private boat for your group
approx$12,500 + tax, up to 100 guests
Same price for any group size. The bus from Los Sueños is extra; I am getting that price now.

Make an evening of it. The boat is back at the marina by 6:00 pm, and Manuel Antonio is just up the hill from Quepos. We can plan a group dinner there with an ocean view before heading back to Los Sueños.

Prefer to keep it simple? There is also a shared sunset sail with snorkeling from Quepos, with transport from the Jacó area, at about $150 per person. Guests can book it on their own any day.

Damas mangroves, near Quepos

  • Private for your group from 12 guests

approx$180 per person + tax
On the beach, at low tide
Horseback Ride on the Beach

The one you have always wanted to do.

  • 4 to 12 riders, so a few friends can join the two of you
  • Pickup at Los Sueños Marriott included
  • The time follows the tide, so I set it once the day is chosen
approx$180 per person + tax
Sportfishing

Private boats right at the Los Sueños marina, a short walk from the hotel. A half day runs from 7:00 am to 12:00 pm. A full day runs until 4:00 pm and adds a BBQ lunch on board. Drinks, snacks, bait and tackle are included, and both boats have a bathroom. The only difference is the size of the boat.

Up to 4 guests
Classic boat
approx$1,200 half day
approx$1,400 full day
Up to 6 guests
Larger 36 foot boat
approx$1,600 half day
approx$1,900 full day

Per boat, plus tax. More space and comfort on the larger boat for a bigger group.
